Clause 2 pins the exact doctored array wrongdeps.ll carries: it claims outputs {4,5,6,7} depend on ViewID and that input i contributes to output 7-i. DXC's own answer for the same shader is [8, 8, 15, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128] -- outputs {0,1,2,3} depend on ViewID and input i contributes to output i -- captured in variant-control-dxc-output. Clause 1 is the anti-vacuity anchor (the module really uses ViewID) and clause 3 records the acceptance.
